## Load Data from MET API

from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os
import requests

load_dotenv()
api_key = os.getenv("MET_API_KEY")

response = requests.get(
    "https://met-employability-services.azurewebsites.net/api/data/",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
)
data = response.json()


## Initialize PySpark DataFrame

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("MET").getOrCreate()
df = spark.createDataFrame(data)
df.show(5)
```
